title: Arrival / setup
intent: Low pressure; progression gate should not fire without beat-shift or high pressure. Quiet establishment.
opening_description: Celina has just stepped inside; Ayame is already in the room. Bags are set down, coats still on. No argument yet—only the awkward pause of two people figuring out how the evening will go.
trigger_text: The door clicks shut behind Celina. Ayame waits without speaking, giving her space to settle in.
